_about: Copy this file into src/content.local/ (a gitignored directory) to get a REVIEW build: the reserved photo places draw their measured shot-cards, so a preview shows the geometry a real photograph will take. Nothing tracked may turn a placeholder on - `npm run check:content` fails any built page carrying a data-placeholder fill, so this cannot reach the apex. Files in that directory deep-merge over src/content.json in filename order (src/lib/content.ts).
_run: mkdir -p src/content.local && cp src/content.local.example.json src/content.local/preview.json && npm run build && npm run verify:browser    then: rm -rf src/content.local
